title: Russell Brand prison message 'appalling' and being investigated, No 10 says
description: Brand's wife read out comments from the comedian on their podcast in which the convicted rapist said he was "not guilty of the offences I have been jailed for".

title: Create more jobs for under-25s by cutting National Insurance, key report urges
description: Some parents are so desperate for their children to find a job that they've offered to pay their wages, one hairdresser has told the BBC.

title: 'I'd throw up in the car park': How school anxiety is harming children's futures
description: As a landmark report about youth unemployment is about to be published, the BBC speaks to school avoiders and those trying to fix the issue.

title: Watch: Why some teenagers don't go to school
description: Teenagers speak to the BBC about struggling with school anxiety ahead of a landmark report on youth unemployment.

title: UK lost more than it gained from Brexit, Burnham to say ahead of EU summit
description: The prime minister will say the "Brexit we were given has not worked" in a speech on Monday.

title: Prince and Princess of Wales play street cricket in Mumbai
description: William and Catherine met locals on their visit to India, ahead of a meeting with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi later in the week.

title: Yellow weather warnings issued for snow as temperatures plummet
description: A spell of colder, wintry weather will grip some northern parts of the UK, bringing a threat of ice and hill snow at times.

title: Barristers must stop using rape myths in trials, justice secretary says
description: Russell Brand's barrister has been accused of peddling rape myths while defending the comedian.

title: Women's criminal records wiped for abortion offences
description: Women arrested or convicted for having illegal abortions will have their criminal records wiped as new atomatic pardons come into force in England and Wales.
